headers.//: Every route is served the same index.html by the rewrite, but a header rule only matches the literal path. '/' and '/index.html' were covered; '/what-if', '/roadmap/...' and every shared '/live-sessions/:id' link were not, so a visitor on a deep link was pinned to an hour-old app shell and saw the previous build. Placed first so the immutable rules below still claim the assets.

Genuinely immutable: canvaskit, fonts, images and the asset bundle. Named explicitly rather than by extension, because a blanket *.js rule swept up flutter_bootstrap.js and cached the app's entry point for a year.

The app shell. None of these carry a content hash, so a cached copy pins a visitor to whatever version they first loaded. flutter_bootstrap.js is the entry point and was being cached for a year, which is why some people saw a build from days ago while others saw today's.
Everyone arrives at '/', not '/index.html'. The rewrite serves index.html but the header rule above never matched this path, so the front door itself was cached for an hour.

redirects.//: The short link for a shared test series. Keeps what gets pasted into a group on the domain people recognise.
